sources.title: Procès du RN : les questions prioritaires de constitutionnalité de Marine Le Pen seront examinées le 16 décembre (Sud Ouest avec AFP)

summary: The Cour de cassation said it will examine on 16 December 2026 the priority questions of constitutionality (QPC) filed with the appeals of Marine Le Pen and co-defendants against their conviction in the FN European assistants case. If referred, the Conseil constitutionnel has three months to rule, delaying the appeal.
